title: Preserve Google identity and administrator continuity across the replacement
description: Given the existing Google-linked administrator and canonical actor references, when the same verified Google issuer/subject signs into the tested replacement, then role continuity and any changed Cognito subject mapping are explicit and verified without pre-created password accounts or invitations. The original pool/profile remains untouched. New Google credential/redirect binding and app-scoped role resources require concrete review before mutation.
